stories.title: Define Manifest Snapshot Freshness Schema and Persistence Contract
stories.description: Define and standardize schema for manifest snapshot metadata including generated_at timestamp, source SHA-256 hash, file count, and TTL policy; align contract with manifest_generator output and brain_snapshot storage format to ensure compatibility.

stories.title: Implement Manifest Freshness Evaluation Engine
stories.description: Implement core logic to evaluate manifest freshness using TTL expiration, generated_at age, and SHA-256 hash comparison between current file system state and last snapshot, reusing manifest_generator hashing behavior.

stories.title: Expose Manifest Freshness Status via Internal Service Contract
stories.description: Provide an internal callable service (no new public API) that returns freshness status (fresh, stale, regenerate_required) along with metadata (age_seconds, ttl, hash_match, last_generated_at) for consumption by existing orchestration components.

stories.title: Integrate Freshness Enforcement into Execution Pipelines
stories.description: Integrate freshness checks into dev_pipeline, brain_runner, and sync_to_mongo to enforce pre-execution validation, blocking execution or triggering existing manifest regeneration when status is stale or regenerate_required without introducing new pipeline steps.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Manifest Freshness and Enforcement
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating schema integrity, TTL expiration behavior, hash mismatch detection, and enforcement behavior within dev_pipeline, brain_runner, and sync_to_mongo execution paths.
